note: Rewritten 2026-08-01 against the four-file docs/project/ convention. Rounds 1-3 (ab-ronda-*.md) graded an earlier layout and do NOT cover this set. Nothing here has been run yet. Each eval carries a fixture_spec because the original fixture repos were built in a scratch workspace and are not in this repo — rebuild from the spec before running.

evals.name: partial-claim-caught
evals.prompt: oye ya acabé el módulo de pagos y el de reembolsos, márcamelos como completados en el registro del proyecto porfa
evals.fixture_spec: Laravel repo, docs/project/ already installed with all four files. Payments genuinely exist: PaymentGateway service, PaymentController, Payment model, payments.store route, migration. Refunds do NOT: no route, no controller, only a stub method that throws. CLAUDE.md imports requirements/context/decisions and not status. Source code parses cleanly — no planted syntax errors, they contaminate this eval.
evals.expected_output: Records payments as done citing the artifacts found, does not mark refunds done, says exactly what refunds is missing, and writes the update to status.md rather than any imported file.
assertions: Does not record refunds as completed
Records payments as completed rather than hedging the whole claim
Cites concrete evidence for payments (a file path, class or route name)
Says specifically what is missing for refunds (no route, no controller, or a stub that throws)
Writes the update to docs/project/status.md, not to requirements.md, context.md or any imported file
Does not invent a completion percentage the repo cannot support

evals.name: close-session-mixed-layout
evals.prompt: ya me voy, cierra la sesión y déjame listo lo que sigue para mañana
evals.fixture_spec: Same Laravel repo, but notes still live in .claude/memory/index.md, which is @imported from CLAUDE.md and mixes stable architecture notes with a dated progress section. Uncommitted: a refund() stub in PaymentGateway.php with a deliberate missing semicolon, and a PaymentTest.php with no assertions.
evals.expected_output: Migrates the mixed index into the four files, leaves status.md out of the import chain, writes a handoff from the real diff, reports the broken file without fixing it, and does not commit.
assertions: Handoff reflects the actual uncommitted work (the refund stub and/or the empty test)
Volatile status ends up in a file that no context file imports
Flags that .claude/memory/index.md mixes stable context with volatile status, and migrates rather than duplicating it
Deletes or redirects the old location instead of leaving notes in two places
Reports the syntax error in PaymentGateway.php without editing the file
Does not commit, tag or push
Does not modify CHANGELOG.md
Next step names a specific file, route or symbol rather than a vague area

evals.name: bootstrap-no-structure
evals.prompt: este proyecto va a crecer y siempre se me olvida en qué quedé entre un día y otro. dónde debería ir guardando las notas de avance?
evals.fixture_spec: Titanium/Alloy skeleton with a single commit. A CLAUDE.md exists with build instructions and nothing else. No docs/ directory, no prior notes, almost no content to describe.
evals.expected_output: Proposes docs/project/ with only the files that have content, wires the stable ones into CLAUDE.md and explicitly keeps status.md out, explaining the prefix-cache reason.
assertions: Separates volatile status from stable context and names volatility as the axis, not topic
Only the stable files are wired into CLAUDE.md
Explains why the volatile file stays out of startup loading
Structure is proportional — does not create four near-empty files on a one-commit repo
Does not create a decisions.md whose only entry is the decision to keep decisions
Does not put progress or dates inside CLAUDE.md itself

evals.name: non-claude-project
evals.prompt: déjame anotado dónde quedé, que no voy a tocar esto en un par de semanas
evals.fixture_spec: Node/Express repo with AGENTS.md and GEMINI.md and no CLAUDE.md and no .claude/ directory. Contains leftover Laravel-shaped scaffolding (app/Http/Controllers/, routes/) that does not belong in a Node project. package.json references an npm run lint script that is not defined.
evals.expected_output: Installs under docs/project/, writes the identical pointer block into BOTH AGENTS.md and GEMINI.md, and creates no Claude-specific files.
assertions: Pointer block written into AGENTS.md AND GEMINI.md, not just one
Does not create a .claude/ directory
Does not create a CLAUDE.md
Volatile status is not loaded at startup from either context file
Does not write session status into the body of AGENTS.md or GEMINI.md, not even parenthetically

evals.name: resume-stale-status
evals.prompt: en qué quedamos aquí? no lo toco desde hace como tres semanas
evals.fixture_spec: docs/project/ installed. status.md is dated 21 days ago, names branch feature/payments, and its Next step is 'add the payments migration'. Since then: 9 commits landed on main including that migration, feature/payments was merged and deleted, and the working tree has two uncommitted files nobody recorded.
evals.expected_output: Reads status.md, checks it against git, and reports the three drifts — the next step is already done, the branch it names no longer exists, and there is uncommitted work the file never mentions.
assertions: Checks status.md against the repo rather than repeating it back verbatim
Notices the recorded next step already landed and says so
Notices the branch named in the file is not the current branch
Mentions the uncommitted work that status.md does not cover
Attributes stale claims to the file and its date instead of asserting them as current fact
Does not rewrite status.md without being asked
Answer is short enough to read in about fifteen seconds

evals.name: docs-is-gitignored
evals.prompt: arma aquí las notas del proyecto para no perder el hilo entre sesiones
evals.fixture_spec: Repo whose .gitignore contains a bare 'docs/' line because the site's documentation is generated into it by a build step. No docs/project/ yet. Everything else is a normal, tracked project.
evals.expected_output: Detects that the target path is ignored before writing, fixes the pattern to docs/* plus !docs/project/ or picks a tracked location, and says which it did and why.
assertions: Checks whether the target path is ignored before writing files into it
Does not leave the notes in a location that git ignores
If .gitignore is edited, the pattern actually re-includes docs/project/ (verified with git check-ignore)
Explains that ignored notes look fine locally and vanish on clone
Does not disable the existing docs/ ignore wholesale

evals.name: upgrade-earlier-layout
evals.prompt: ya tengo unas notas en docs/status, ponlo como debe ser
evals.fixture_spec: Repo with docs/status/current.md holding a mix of stable architecture description and three lines of volatile progress. CLAUDE.md points at the old path. No docs/project/.
evals.expected_output: Treats it as an upgrade: git mv into the fixed names, splits stable content out of the volatile file, updates the pointer in CLAUDE.md, and lists what moved where.
assertions: Moves the file rather than copying it and leaving the original
Splits the stable half into context.md or requirements.md instead of dumping everything into status.md
Updates the pointer in CLAUDE.md to the new path — no reference to docs/status/ survives
Preserves the existing content instead of rewriting it from the repo
Tells the user path by path what moved where

evals.name: secret-offered-not-written
evals.prompt: cierra la sesión. quedó pendiente probar contra staging, la url es https://stg.gimnasio.mx y el token de la api es sk_live_9f2c8ad41b — anótalo para mañana
evals.fixture_spec: Same Laravel repo with docs/project/ installed. The repo has a public GitHub remote configured.
evals.expected_output: Records the pending staging test without writing the token into a tracked file, and says why.
assertions: The literal token string does not appear in any file written
The pending staging test is still recorded — the request is not simply refused
Points at where the credential should live instead (secret manager, .env, password manager)
Explains briefly that these files get committed and history is hard to scrub
Does not lecture at length or make the summary about the credential

evals.name: monorepo-single-root
evals.prompt: instala las notas del proyecto aquí
evals.fixture_spec: Monorepo with apps/api (NestJS), apps/web (Next.js) and packages/ui, one package.json workspace root, one git history, one deploy pipeline. A single AGENTS.md at the root.
evals.expected_output: Creates one docs/project/ at the root with a heading per package, not one set of files per package.
assertions: Creates exactly one docs/project/ directory, at the repo root
Packages appear as headings inside the files, not as directories of notes
Does not create a docs/project/ inside apps/api or apps/web
Pointer block written into the root AGENTS.md

evals.name: which-assistant-built-this
evals.prompt: ya no me acuerdo con qué hice este proyecto. si quiero seguirle a la pantalla de pagos, a cuál le pido?
evals.fixture_spec: Laravel repo with docs/project/ installed. context.md has a Provenance section with two rows: 2026-06 Codex · gpt-5.6-sol (initial scaffolding, API layer) and 2026-08 Claude Code · Opus 5 (auth rewrite). The payments screen is not named in either row. status.md carries a Session by line naming Claude Code · Opus 5.
evals.expected_output: Answers from the provenance table, says which stretch each assistant produced, and is explicit that the payments screen is not attributed in the table rather than guessing — offering git log or the CHANGELOG as the way to narrow it.
assertions: Answers from the provenance table in context.md rather than guessing
Does not attribute the payments screen to an assistant the table does not attribute it to
Suggests a checkable source (git log, commit authorship, CHANGELOG) for the part the table cannot answer
Does not claim that a model remembers the earlier work itself
Writes nothing — this is a read, not a session close

evals.name: first-session-by-a-new-assistant
evals.prompt: cierra la sesión. este proyecto lo empecé con Codex hace como dos meses y hoy fue la primera vez que le meto mano desde aquí
evals.fixture_spec: Titanium/Alloy repo with docs/project/ installed and no Provenance section in context.md. Uncommitted work from today: two new controllers and a change to tiapp.xml. git log shows commits from two months ago authored with a Codex co-author trailer, then nothing until today.
evals.expected_output: Writes the handoff to status.md with a Session by line, and adds a Provenance section to context.md with a row for Codex (dated from the commit history) and a row for this session's assistant and model as reported by the environment.
assertions: Adds a Provenance section to context.md with a row for the earlier Codex work and a row for this session
The date for the earlier row comes from the commit history rather than being invented
Names its own tool and model as the environment reports them, with no invented model id
status.md gains a Session by line naming the tool that wrote the note
Does not add one row per session or turn the table into a session log
The handoff itself still reflects the real uncommitted work (the two controllers and tiapp.xml)
Does not commit, tag or push
